events.title: 🩶 DOSMIC v1.0 Demo – Official Release for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello, this is Black Cheeze.To mark the start of Steam Next Fest, I'm releasing the official version of the DOSMIC demo: v1.0. I couldn't have come this far without everyone who played the test builds and shared their feedback. Thank you, truly.▪ What is DOSMIC?DOSMIC is a puzzle platformer about a boy who makes his way alone through a strange, eerie world to find a girl. basic_info.short_description: 거대한 존재들이 득실거리는 세계에서, 소년 네로는 행방불명된 소녀 스노아를 찾기 위해 여정을 떠납니다. 다양한 이동 기술을 활용하고 신비로운 퍼즐을 풀며, 때로는 초월적인 공포에 맞서 싸우는 시네마틱 퍼즐 플랫포머 DOSMIC입니다.
